title: SCAP-NG 0.4 draft unified Assessment predicates
description: SCAP-NG 0.4.0 Assessment predicates: structured Item requirements and explicit field_requirement scopes. Legacy State arrays and scalar Test.require are invalid. Schema acceptance does not establish scanner conformance.

cardinality.description: Consistent 0.4 authoring cardinality vocabulary. 'every' means all relevant results satisfy the specified comparison; source OVAL lexical values belong in provenance only.

existence_cardinality.description: State field/record existence cardinality. Preserve the OVAL entity/record all_exist distinction pending separate evidence review.

item_existence_cardinality.description: Collected NG Items have no synthetic does-not-exist entries. OVAL Test all_exist and at_least_one_exists both map to one_or_more; preserve their original source attributes in provenance.

paired_requirement.description: Explicit field existence and matching cardinalities inherited together. Comparator-free absence is authored only on the individual field as values_found: none.

value_match.description: Required on arrays, Variable references and Organizational Inputs. Independent of the observed-Item/State/record requirement.

items_found.description: Selected-Item existence requirement (OVAL Test check_existence). Both source all_exist and at_least_one_exists map to one_or_more; preserve their distinct source spellings only in provenance.

items_satisfying.description: How many collected Items must satisfy the complete condition (OVAL Test check). Never conflated with items_found.

field_requirement.description: Optional shared values_found/values_matching pair for fields in this Test, overridden only by a closer complete pair on a group, condition, or individual field. No implicit field requirement.

fields.description: One complete condition; distinct fields are combined with logical AND.

canonical_all_items_requirement.description: One complete Test requirement: items_found is existence, items_satisfying is comparison aggregation. Conditions follow directly as fields/and/or/one/xor. Omitted field cardinality is never silently defaulted.
